headerDisplay: Xiaomi 1080p local camera plugin. Most tuning options have safe defaults and can still be added manually to config.json when debugging.

cloudBootstrap.title: MISS Descriptor Source
cloudBootstrap.description: Use cached local MISS descriptors during normal operation. If the cache is missing, fallback refreshes it once through the cached Xiaomi session. Use local only after the descriptor cache exists.

oneOf.title: Use cache, fallback to Xiaomi cloud

twoWayAudio.title: Two-Way Audio / Talkback
twoWayAudio.description: Advertises HomeKit Talk support. Camera speaker transport is still experimental.

backgroundMonitoring.title: Background Still Image / Motion Monitoring
backgroundMonitoring.description: Keeps a lightweight local SUB stream open for still images and motion detection.

motionDetection.title: Motion Detection
motionDetection.description: Uses native Xiaomi motion events when available and local SUB packet activity as a cloud-free fallback for HomeKit motion/HKSV.

localHttpApi.title: Local Diagnostics API
localHttpApi.description: Exposes local health/status/snapshot endpoints for troubleshooting. Leave off for normal use. Non-loopback access requires a token.

localHttpHost.title: Local Diagnostics API Host
localHttpHost.description: Bind diagnostics to loopback by default. Use 0.0.0.0 only with a strong Local Diagnostics API Token.

localHttpToken.title: Local Diagnostics API Token
localHttpToken.description: Bearer token for protected local diagnostics/control endpoints when Local Diagnostics API is enabled.
